claim.title: realtime simulation 必须记录心跳、断线、延迟和数据 stale 状态
claim.statement: 实时模拟和 sandbox execution 必须记录 heartbeat、disconnect、reconnect、latency、data stale、order event lag、adapter error 和 recovery evidence；这些指标只能说明环境健康和 adapter 稳定性，不等于交易许可或策略有效。
claim.evidence_summary: Google SRE describes monitoring systems with symptoms, causes and golden signals such as latency, traffic, errors and saturation.；NautilusTrader separates backtest, sandbox and live contexts while sharing core runtime architecture.；CEK-TA internal contract defines EnvironmentManifest fields, owner boundaries and machine gate restrictions.
